title: Resource-Efficient Reinforcement Learning Post-Training through Elastic Expert Parallelism
abstract: arXiv:2611.06984v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reinforcement learning post-training improves the capabilities of large language models, but generating training responses is a major computational bottleneck. In mixture-of-experts models, workers that finish their assigned responses may remain occupied because their experts are still needed by workers processing longer responses. Consequently, approximately one-third of occupied worker time in the baseline occurs after local response generation finishes. Here we present FlexFloor, a system that enables earlier resource release during synchronous response generation while preserving the expert computation required by ongoing responses. FlexFloor jointly adapts response scheduling and the active group of workers. It uses historical response lengths and memory constraints to guide batching and prompt placement, then progressively releases workers while maintaining expert availability and correct communication. Compared with the verl basel

translated_title: 通过弹性专家并行实现资源高效的强化学习后训练
translated_abstract: 强化学习后训练能够提升大型语言模型的能力，但生成训练响应是一个主要的计算瓶颈。在混合专家模型中，已完成本地响应生成的 worker 可能仍处于占用状态，因为它们持有的专家仍被正在处理更长响应的 worker 所需要。因此，在基线方法中，约三分之一的 worker 占用时间发生在本地响应生成完成之后。本文提出了 FlexFloor，一个能够在同步响应生成过程中更早释放资源、同时保留进行中响应所需专家计算的系统。FlexFloor 联合调整响应调度与活跃 worker 组：它利用历史响应长度和内存约束来指导批处理与提示词放置，然后渐进式地释放 worker，同时保持专家的可用性和通信的正确性。与 verl 基线相比……
tldr: 提出 FlexFloor 系统，通过联合调整响应调度与活跃 worker 组，利用历史响应长度和内存约束实现同步响应生成过程中 worker 的渐进式提前释放，从而大幅提升混合专家模型强化学习后训练的资源效率。
en_tdlr: FlexFloor jointly adapts response scheduling and the active group of workers, using historical response lengths and memory constraints to progressively release workers earlier during synchronous RL response generation, thereby significantly improving resource efficiency of MoE post-training.
